mechanism: Both drugs have anticholinergic properties and CNS depressant effects; atomoxetine is metabolized by CYP2D6 which chlorpromazine may inhibit, potentially increasing atomoxetine levels.
action: Monitor for increased atomoxetine side effects (tremor, tachycardia, hypertension) and anticholinergic symptoms; consider dose adjustment if needed; avoid in patients with cardiac arrhythmias.
